Mr. Sidharth Bankoti, legal aid counsel for the appellant.

2.  This is an appeal against conviction filed through legal aid counsel.

By the impugned judgment dated 18.02.2025, passed by Special Judge (POCSO)/Additional District and Sessions Judge,
Dehradun in Special Sessions Trial No. 28 of 2021, appellant was convicted for offence punishable under Sections 376 IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act and sentenced to 20 years rigorous imprisonment with fine of Rs. 10,000/-.

sentences.text: 3. There is delay of 24 days in filing the Appeal.

Learned State Counsel fairly submits that since the appeal is filed through legal aid counsel and the appellant is in jail, therefore, he do not propose to file any objection to the Delay Condonation Application.
4. For the reasons indicated in the delay condonation application, we condone the delay.
Delay Condonation Application stands disposed of.
Objection(s), if any, to the Bail Application be filed in the meantime.
